summary.text: Sarah Boses is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a member of the Santa Fe Public Schools Board of Education, representing District 2, with a term ending in 2027.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Boses has served on the Santa Fe Public Schools Board of Education, representing District 2, and her current term ends in 2027.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
